from rules import acyclic, candidates


def solve(data):
    packages = data.get('packages', {})
    roots = data.get('roots', {})
    blocked = data.get('blocked', {})
    pins = data.get('pins', {})
    features = set(data.get('features', []))
    names = sorted(packages)

    constraints = {name: [tuple(bounds)] for name, bounds in roots.items()}
    required = set(roots)
    best = None
    best_key = None

    def search(versions, limits, graph, needed):
        nonlocal best, best_key

        pending = sorted(needed - versions.keys())
        if not pending:
            key = tuple(versions.get(name, -1) for name in names)
            if best_key is None or key > best_key:
                best_key = key
                best = dict(versions)
            return

        name = pending[0]
        rows = candidates(
            packages.get(name, []),
            limits.get(name, []),
            blocked.get(name, []),
            pins.get(name),
        )
        for row in rows:
            version = row['version']
            next_versions = dict(versions)
            next_versions[name] = version
            next_limits = {key: list(value) for key, value in limits.items()}
            next_graph = {key: set(value) for key, value in graph.items()}
            next_graph.setdefault(name, set())
            next_needed = set(needed)
            valid = True

            for dep in row.get('deps', []):
                feature = dep.get('feature')
                if feature and feature not in features:
                    continue
                target = dep['name']
                interval = (dep['min'], dep['max'])
                next_limits.setdefault(target, []).append(interval)
                next_needed.add(target)
                next_graph[name].add(target)
                next_graph.setdefault(target, set())
                if target in next_versions and not all(
                    low <= next_versions[target] <= high
                    for low, high in next_limits[target]
                ):
                    valid = False
                    break

            if valid and acyclic(next_graph):
                search(next_versions, next_limits, next_graph, next_needed)

    search({}, constraints, {}, required)
    if best is None:
        return {'error': 'unsatisfiable'}
    return {'versions': best}
